title: Rectangle Area
goal: Solve Rectangle Area: Compute the total area covered by two axis-aligned rectangles.
strategy: Compute the total area covered by two axis-aligned rectangles.
edgeCases: Touching rectangles have zero overlap area; clamp negative overlap widths or heights to zero before multiplying.
inputRules: Rectangle A needs ax2 >= ax1 and ay2 >= ay1
Rectangle B needs bx2 >= bx1 and by2 >= by1
